description: This Java class implements the CalendarReadPlatformService interface for the Fineract project, providing methods to retrieve and process calendar data from a database, including calendar details, recurring dates, and associations with entities such as loans, clients, and groups.

classes.name: CalendarReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CalendarReadPlatformService interface, providing various methods to access and process calendar data from the database.

classes.name: CalendarDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL query results to CalendarData objects for current calendar entries.

classes.name: CalendarDataFromHistoryMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL query results to CalendarData objects from calendar history records.

methods.name: retrieveCalendar
methods.description: Retrieve specific calendar data by calendar ID, entity ID, and entity type.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieve calendars associated with a specific entity, optionally filtered by calendar type options.

methods.name: retrieveCollctionCalendarByEntity
methods.description: Retrieve the collection calendar linked to a specific entity.

methods.name: retrieveParentCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieve parent calendars for an entity, considering hierarchy and calendar types.

methods.name: retrieveNewCalendarDetails
methods.description: Get default values and details for creating a new calendar.

methods.name: generateRecurringDates
methods.description: Generate recurring dates based on calendar data, optionally including history, up to a specified date.

methods.name: generateNextTenRecurringDates
methods.description: Generate the next ten recurrence dates for a calendar.

methods.name: isCalendarAssociatedWithEntity
methods.description: Check if a calendar is associated with a given entity.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalendar
methods.description: Retrieve the calendar associated with a loan ID.

methods.name: getParentHierarchyCondition
methods.description: Generate SQL condition for hierarchy-based parent calendar retrieval based on entity type.

methods.name: retrieveApplicableCalendarFromHistory
methods.description: Retrieve calendar data from history records for a specific calendar and date.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarsFromHistory
methods.description: Retrieve all calendar history records for a specified calendar.

methods.name: getSeedDate
methods.description: Return the seed date, defaulted to given date.

methods.name: getPeriodStartDate
methods.description: Calculate the start date of the period for recurrence generation.

methods.name: getPeriodEndDate
methods.description: Calculate the end date of the recurrence period, considering various constraints.

methods.name: generateNextEligibleMeetingDateForCollection
methods.description: Calculate next eligible meeting date for collections, considering last meeting and calendar schedule.

methods.name: updateWithRecurringDates
methods.description: Update a collection of calendars with their generated recurring dates.
